ownership: Root proposed the RUN/RIM imperative valencies and q-e supplement realization. bounded_idea_supply reviewed parsing, completeness, circularity and predecessor limits. This is an author-exposed hand construction, not a blind test, new RAW architecture or native result.

new_bounded_source_contract.inherited: Use975's sixteen ordinary word spellings, ordinary minim writer, exact NAME mode, old noun/property/relation clause forms, PERIOD and physical continuation rule. Names remain exact and open only over the declared finite name alphabet. No ordinary unknown word or unstated valency is admitted.
new_bounded_source_contract.termination: Each of these clauses, like every inherited clause, has its actual PERIOD group. It does not end silently before an unexplained extra name or other token.
new_bounded_source_contract.semantic_cost: ADDRESSEE is a publicly stipulated participant of the addressed-message convention, not a recovered native person or a target-dependent antecedent. RUN means locomotion here, while the old noun run remains a watercourse. The new RIM verb is a learned operation predicate; it does not identify the rim material, amount or individual rim unless the source supplies such information elsewhere. These two global sense/valency entries are real additional learning costs. No negative imperative, optional object, noun-only clause or new list production is included.

public_context_construction: Reassemble complete physical groups before reading codes, as975 requires.

Identify exact NAME groups and PERIOD. For every ordinary group, separate an optional supplement field at the single q-e delimiter; remove ALL such supplement fields temporarily. Do not use a supplemented neighbor's inferred word in this initial stage.
For each ordinary base group, collect all ordinary source spellings whose unchanged975 writer gives exactly that base. Preserve each licensed noun/verb sense separately when testing the grammar.

Enumerate every full-clause parse through the inherited grammar plus the two new productions, using only the base groups, exact names and PERIOD. Let P0 be this public parse set. For position j, D_j is the set of source spellings appearing there in P0.

The writer computes these sets from its own base-only rendering and the public grammar; the reader computes the same sets by stripping the written supplements. Neither needs the intended lexical answer to construct P0. Names are independently literal and therefore do not depend on supplement choices.

Reject an empty P0 or an input outside the declared source grammar. The actual source parse must belong to P0. This construction uses a small bounded clause grammar, not an unrestricted semantic oracle or an answer list chosen separately for each occurrence.

position_scope_correction.old971: 971 explicitly assumes one source letter maps to one non-erasing skeleton unit, so ambiguous source positions are visible through that projection.
position_scope_correction.new_minim_carrier: 975 instead expands i/n/u/m to one/two/two/three working strokes. Source-letter positions are not generally recoverable by numbering the visible strokes. Thus this is a concrete realization of971's context/complement principle with an explicitly changed skeleton interface, not an unchanged instance of its one-unit projection premise.
position_scope_correction.why_this_bounded_case_is_complete: The only distinct ordinary spellings which collide in the fixed dictionary are rim and run. Both have three source letters and the same first letter r; their source positions2 and3 are minim letters. These positions are obtained from the openly taught candidate words, not from a supposed native minim segmentation. The first visited position is2. It contains i in rim and u in run and therefore distinguishes the pair immediately.
position_scope_correction.not_a_generic_solution: A larger dictionary could contain candidates of different source lengths or incompatible minim segmentations. Such a dictionary would require a new completely specified position/address rule. This note does not silently generalize the one position2 complement to those cases.

paid_supplement_carrier.format: An ordinary group with a nonempty supplement is BASE followed by [q,e] followed by the exact literal codes of the supplement letters. An empty supplement is written by absence of both delimiter and payload. No physical space is inserted inside the group.
paid_supplement_carrier.exact_letters: Use975's exact NAME payload letter codes, without NAMEOPEN or NAMECLOSE. In this bounded ordinary application only i->[q,p] and u->[q,ckh] are actually needed. All other existing codes and the exact-name branch remain unchanged.
paid_supplement_carrier.no_collision: q-e occurs in no975 ordinary base, name payload, NAME frame, PERIOD or CONTINUATION code. Every existing q-code has another second unit; no payload code ends in q. Thus q-e cannot arise across two complete base codes either. It is an unambiguous reserved delimiter after physical reassembly.
paid_supplement_carrier.canonicality: At most one q-e delimiter is permitted in an ordinary group. It must have a nonempty valid exact-letter payload and no subsequent delimiter. A complement in a NAME group, an unnecessary complement or any complement beyond the earliest unique stop is invalid for this new canonical writer.
paid_supplement_carrier.cost: Every noun rim/run requires the two-unit delimiter and one two-unit exact letter: four additional working units. Its ordinary group is nine units instead of five. The imperative uses the five-unit bare group. No extra glyph type is added, but one formerly unused q selector and its interpretation must be learned. Any extra line fragmentation costs the inherited explicit continuation groups. No net saving or native length fit is claimed.

writer_and_reader: Compute all D_j from the same base-only P0, independently of every supplement. If D_j is already a singleton, write no supplement.

If D_j={rim,run}, visit source position2 and append its actual i or u in the paid field. The candidate set immediately becomes the intended singleton; stop. All other ordinary dictionary words have singleton spelling sets in every valid source context of this contract.

The reader uses the same D_j and source-position order, applies the supplements, requires a unique spelling at every ordinary site and checks that stopping was earliest. An omitted noun complement leaves two readings and is invalid in THIS exact-recovery realization; it remains a valid ambiguous message under unchanged975.

Reparse the complete recovered clause. In this limited grammar its complete source-word sequence has one grammatical/sense analysis: old clauses start with a noun phrase, while the new imperative forms start with run or rim and have their fixed argument count. Return the noun/proposition or directive content accordingly.

Preserve the exact NAME value, all inherited negation scopes, actual PERIOD boundaries and message order. The returned source spelling and declared content are unique on the new domain. The procedure does not choose among unresolved word senses by general plausibility.

hand_cases.readback: The literal i at source position2 selects rim. Content: exists x [RIM(x) and WARM(x)].
The literal u at source position2 selects run. Content: exists x [RUN_AS_WATERCOURSE(x) and WARM(x)]. All other groups are as in the preceding case.
RIM's required named object is absent, so only DIRECTIVE LOCOMOTE(ADDRESSEE) is grammatical. No supplement is written or needed.
RUN permits no explicit object and the visible NAME cannot be discarded. Only DIRECTIVE APPLY_RIM_TO(ADDRESSEE,NAME('vat')) remains. No supplement is written or needed.

full_message_and_circularity_check: Any ordered concatenation of the complete example clauses is read clause by clause at the paid PERIOD controls. Unknown names remain completely literal; no neighboring clause selects a hidden participant.

In an inherited relation clause with two ambiguous noun sites, P0 contains all combinations of rim/run at the two positions. Each site's supplement is determined from P0 and its own intended spelling, not from the other site's supplement. Both are necessary under the declared base-context rule.

The source parse is contained in P0. Complement filtering retains it while making each ordinary spelling unique. The fixed grammatical frames then supply the unique lexical category and sense. This proves completeness on this declared domain without a simultaneous guessing loop.

No claim is made of globally minimal total message annotation under arbitrary grammars. In more coupled grammars, one paid annotation could make another redundant; the current rule deliberately defines every D_j before ANY annotation is used.
known_limits_retained: 975 remains byte-frozen as a different set-valued reader. This assessment does not alter its lexicon, projection, grammar or canonical language in place.

971's original raw remains byte-frozen. The concrete public context interface is now constructively exemplified, but its one-letter/one-skeleton-unit premise has not been falsely attributed to the minim carrier.

The new imperative frames do not create an unmarked noun list, optional argument or AAA repair. Under a direct complete-logical-word reading the old short teaching grammar remains narrow; no native whole text is covered by this demonstration.
minimum still has fifteen ordinary minim strokes. Exact names retain their full quote/escape cost. No run cap, new alias, native role, native vowel value or convenient source corpus is selected.

Logical ordinary-word behavior and physical group counts remain different because PERIOD and continuation groups are written. Old whole-word source-frequency gates cannot be transferred to the entire physical stream without their original denominator assumptions. No such comparison is made here.

The grammar, dictionary and imperative valencies are explicitly invented teaching inputs. The result supplies no historical attestation, unknown-key recovery, learned native syntax or manuscript prediction with independently bound meanings.

predecessor_difference.GDT1160: Its retained positive is supervised ranking of real editorial expansion candidates using context, with residual errors. This construction supplies exact, globally stipulated grammatical valency and changes what the writer transmits; it neither reruns nor improves1160. The broad fact that context can help is old knowledge.
predecessor_difference.GDT1171: Its fixed open-vocabulary contextual model failure remains. A sixteen-spelling controlled grammar is not evidence that its cross-word model should have succeeded.
predecessor_difference.IDEA000971: This is a bounded positive hand realization of the previously missing public-context/supplement interface, with the skeleton-interface qualification above. No new idea card is needed merely to count the realization as another mechanism.

decision: Positive bounded constructive assessment: the explicitly taught imperative valencies supply a noncircular difference between contexts requiring one paid letter and contexts requiring none. No new RAW card, native experiment, encoder, source acquisition, payload query or mutation of earlier contracts. Root owns any subsequent review or selection.
